text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy to prod finished for release r2026-04. Canary shard canary-17 showing error rate 5.3% (threshold 0.5%), pausing rollout.
incident-bot: Page sent to SRE oncall -> Raj Patel. Priority: P1.
Raj Patel: I'm on. Pulling logs + smoke tests. Which shard and model variant?
Alice Chen: shard=canary-17, variant=new-v3.5-quant. Seeing tokenizer timeouts and 502s from model-host-42.
Tom Li: model-host-42 shows repeated OOMs in the runtime logs, mem pressure ramps pre-request. New variant has different cache behavior.
Raj Patel: Ok - immediate mitigation: flip feature flag ml.new_model=false to steer traffic off canary. If error rate doesn't drop under 1% in 5m we'll roll back.
Alice Chen: Flipped flag ml.new_model=false :white_check_mark: Confirming traffic shift.
Maya Gomez: Creating incident bridge and notifying CS. Drafting customer-facing note: "Intermittent errors observed during canary deploy; mitigating now."
deploy-bot: Observability update: after flag flip error rate is 0.9% (was 5.3%). Continuing to monitor for 2m before rollback decision.
Tom Li: Preparing rollback plan in case of re-escalation. Pre-rollback steps: 1) drain canary pods, 2) run rollback command, 3) verify smoke tests.
Raj Patel: Let's prepare manual rollback now to speed things if needed. Tom, be ready to run `./deploy rollback --to=stable-2026-03-31 --no-canary-promote`.
Tom Li: Ready. Starting drain of canary endpoints: `traffic-siphon --from=canary-17 --to=stable --grace=30s`.
deploy-bot: Automated rollback not triggered (thresholds met), manual rollback authorized by Raj Patel. Executing rollback: `./deploy rollback --to=stable-2026-03-31 --force`.
Alice Chen: Rollback logs: all canary replicas replaced with stable bundle. No schema migrations.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed across eu/west/us regions. Service health checks green.
Raj Patel: Verification: running synthetic prompt smoke tests and end-to-end flows. Latency and error rate back to baseline.
Alice Chen: Smoke tests OK — generation latencies normal, 5xx count = 0 in last 3m.
Maya Gomez: CS update: status page updated, customers emailed about mitigation and next steps.
Tom Li: Handoff: I'll take post-rollback ownership to collect logs and open a postmortem. Recommend blocking new-v3.5-quant variant until root cause identified.
Raj Patel: Stepping down from oncall for this incident. Thanks for quick responses.
oncall-sre: Incident marked resolved. Monitoring set to elevated for 24h.
Alice Chen: Action items: (1) investigate OOM pattern on model-host-42, (2) add canary circuit breaker to limit traffic per-variant, (3) update runbook to include immediate flag flip + traffic siphon steps. I'll open PRs.
Tom Li: Scheduling 30m sync to capture timeline and assign postmortem owners.
Raj Patel: +1. Great work everyone.
